name: Wipro Ltd.
business_summary: India's fourth-largest listed IT services group (Azim Premji ~72.6% promoter holding). Segments: IT services (Americas ~58%, Europe ~30%, APMEA ~12%, model knowledge) with BFSI ~30%, consumer, health and technology/communications verticals, plus a small IT products line and Capco consulting. TTM sales Rs97,023 cr, EBITDA ~19%, PAT ~Rs13,200 cr, net cash, dividend yield 5.6%. Q3 FY27 guide is -1.5% to +0.5% QoQ constant currency, large-deal bookings hit a 19-quarter low in Q2, and the stock trades at 14.9x P/E near six-year lows (up 22% in the last month).

exposures.mechanism: ~95% of revenue foreign-currency, ~45% of costs INR (model knowledge). +3% USD/INR => ~+1.3pp margin pre-hedge on 19.5% EBITDA => +6.7% EBITDA; hedge book and wage/pass-through leakage keep ~35% (persistence 0.35); EV/MCap ~0.9 (net cash) => +2.1, shaded to +1.8. Pack elasticity is negative (-2.52, t -1.7): not significant, reflects risk-off co-movement; fundamental sign retained, range extends below zero.

evidence.note: Screener: Sep-26 qtr sales 24,753 cr, OPM 20%, PAT 3,200 cr, P/E 14.9, yield 5.58%

exposures.mechanism: Americas ~ 58% of revenue (model knowledge). +1pp US growth => IT services +1.5pp => revenue +0.9%; incremental margin 30% on 19.5% => EBITDA +1.4%; with growth re-rating (persistence ~1) => ~+2.5. Currently weak: Q3 guide -1.5%..+0.5% CC.

evidence.note: Q3 FY27 IT-services CC guide -1.5% to +0.5% QoQ; large-deal bookings 19-quarter low; ADR -4.5% then recovered

exposures.mechanism: Europe ~ 30% of revenue (largest among peers; model knowledge), BFSI/consumer. +1pp EU growth => revenue +0.45%; incremental margin => EBITDA +0.7%, with re-rating => ~+1.6.

exposures.mechanism: SSU +1 = ~3% repricing of base. Wipro has the weakest AI-led deal momentum of the large caps (large-deal bookings -76% YoY, 19-quarter low) and large legacy infrastructure/BPS pools most exposed to automation: 3% x 65% flow-through => EBITDA -10%; persistence 0.6 => -6. Livemint (2026-10-15) notes an 'anti-AI trade' lifted Wipro ADRs - the market is pricing deflation risk both ways.

evidence.note: Livemint: ADRs +5% two-month high; anti-AI trade

Wipro has the lowest H-1B dependence of the Indian big five (local hiring), onsite cost +1.5pp of revenue => -7.7% EBITDA; 50% passed through; persistence 0.6 => ~-3. PERM suspension of 2026-10-08 and $100k H-1B fee litigation (struck down 2026-10-01) did not hurt the stock.
